newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-HAMED RETAINS WBO TITLE WITH QUICK KNOCK-OUT.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-HAMED RETAINS WBO TITLE WITH QUICK KNOCK-OUT.

text.p: Britain's Naseem Hamed needed barely two rounds to retain his World Boxing Organisation (WBO) featherweight title on Saturday when he stopped Argentina's Remigio Molina with a barrage of savage blows.

Hamed wasted little time answering his critics who have doubted the fighter after two disappointing defences of his title when he stopped the previously unbeaten Molina with a little less than 30 seconds remaining of round two.
The 22-year-old, who was defending his own unbeaten record, floored his opponent early in the second round of the 10-round bout.
Molina managed to get to his feet, but the referee made a timely intervention as Hamed unleashed another flurry of punches.
